evidence_plan.requirement: Performance results of traditional and deep learning models

payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results related to oversampled datasets, various machine learning models, and transfer learning comparisons.

claims.text: Oversampled datasets (F+, T+, W+) show significantly better performance than their counterparts (F, T, W).
DNN models showed a major leap in performance across all evaluation measures after data replication.
Transfer Learning (TL1) resulted in significantly low recall, indicating different nature of cyberbullying across datasets.
